page0.text:
...Should I try using a Command Spell?
I don't think Saber would lose to Assassin.
But this situation is too unfavorable.
This is that old fiend we're talking here. It's too dangerous to let Saber fight alone.

page1.text: "So you've managed to rein in that clumsy bloodlust. You must be scheming something."

page2.text:
His chuckle is condescending.
It's a laugh that says he'll let me try anything I want, since it's all child's play.

page3.text:
...
Fine, go ahead and laugh.
If Command Spells are supposed to respond to my wishes, then I'll use as many as it takes to call Saber back!

page4.text:
"Saber!"
Without taking my eyes off the shadows before me, I focus my will on my left hand.
I give one simple order.
I call Saber back to my side immediately!

page5.text:
"Mngh!?"
He notices too late.
My left hand blazes with warmth, releasing its compressed magical energy in response to its Master's wishes...
...and loses its color after a brief moment of pain.

page6.text:
"Huh?"
I wish it only failed.
I'd like to believe that I used it wrong, because I don't know how it works.

page7.text:
"...Phew. Looks like it's over. That gave me quite a fright. It must have taken ten years off my life."
His laughter grates on my ears.
...Far away, I hear wind howling, like a death cry.

page8.text:
My left hand throbs in pain.
The back of my hand is tingling.
It hurts where the Command Spells are, almost like I'm bleeding there.

page9.text:
"It...can't be..."
I feel awful dread.
I feel awful dread.
I feel awful dread.
The pain in my left hand.
The howling wind, gone silent.
The old, insect-wielding mage, laughter filling the room with his bloodlust.

page10.text: "No, it's cold hard reality. If you're her Master, you should be able to tell that your Servant is gone from this world!"

page11.text:
...
My mind is paralyzed.
My vision freezes.
What...is he talking about?

page12.text:
"What are you so shocked for? Saber is dead. She underestimated Assassin and lost to him. Is that so hard to grasp, boy?"
"That's..."

page13.text:
...bullshit, right?
My left hand hurts.
It really hurts.
But my Command Spells are still there.
They're growing fainter by the second, like they're about to fade, but they aren't gone yet.
Then Saber still has to be out there, ready to come to me right now!

page14.text:
"Don't you..."
"Let's put an end to this. The Tohsaka girl still has potential, but I have no further use for you. Die in my holy land, along with your Servant!"
"...BULLSHIT ME, MOTHERFUCKER!"

page15.text:
I run.
I charge at the enemy before me, trying to shake off the pain in my left hand and the horrible dread.
